description: This Java class 'MongoConfig' configures MongoDB connection settings using environment variables within a Spring framework application. It extends AbstractMongoClientConfiguration to provide custom MongoClient creation based on environment variables 'MONGODB_URL' and 'MONGODB_DB'.

classes.name: MongoConfig
classes.description: A Spring configuration class that sets up MongoDB client connection with environment variables.

methods.name: getDatabaseName
methods.description: Returns the name of the MongoDB database, specified by the 'MONGODB_DB' environment variable.

methods.name: mongoClient
methods.description: Creates and returns a MongoClient instance configured with the connection string from 'MONGODB_URL'.
